text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Pardon me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...Hehe. Did you figure it out from
my
fidgeting?
choice_data_list: 寄り道のお誘いか？
寄り道のお誘いかな？
choice_data_list_en: Are you inviting me to take a detour?
Are you inviting me to take a detour?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The thought of happening upon yet
another
wonderful discovery while
walking with you... It
made my heart
sing, you see.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, Mejiro Ardan and I pick a
direction
and start walking...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan comes to a sudden stop in
front of a
greengrocer in the shopping
district. I can see her
staring intently at
something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, do these apples not look
absolutely
delicious?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow her gaze to see a ton of red,
beautifully
ripe apples lined up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to purchase a few. Please wait
here a
moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Now then... back to our detour. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe she wants to find a park where
we can sit
down and eat the apples? As
I'm thinking through
all the possible
places where we might end up...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oddly enough, Mejiro Ardan leads me
back to my
office at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, what a funny thing to say. We're
still very
much in the midst of the
detour!
choice_data_list: あれ……寄り道は？
choice_data_list_en: Wait... what about our detour?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Our outings usually end once we return to campus and go our separate ways, yes? But couldn't you say that coming here with our souvenirs has made this something of a detour?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It is indeed! ♪ Now, I shall set about
peeling the
apples.
choice_data_list: そういうものか……
そういうものかな……
choice_data_list_en: So that's how it is...
Is that really how it goes...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Now, please enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
Apples
are so nutritious that there's a
saying about them.
choice_data_list: いただきます
choice_data_list_en: Thank you for the food.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My nanny always used to peel apples for
me when
I was younger, so I do believe
that I know a good
apple when I see
one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: What do you think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm glad. I'm very partial to this
type of
apple myself.
choice_data_list: おいしい！
choice_data_list_en: Delicious!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Though, I have mixed feelings about
the fruit
itself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Most of the times I've been given apples
to eat
were when I was sick in bed... or
at the hospital.
choice_data_list: どうして？
choice_data_list_en: Why?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The apples Nanny prepared for me at
such times
always had a soft, reassuring
flavor... To me, that
was how apples
tasted.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
As if the reality of my situation was
sinking in
deeper with every bite.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I found myself wanting to know for

sure—whether I'd feel differently about
the taste
now.
choice_data_list: それなら、なぜ今……
choice_data_list_en: In that case, why now...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I've learned both to run and to enjoy
these lovely
detours with you. Perhaps
given how I've
changed...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chomp.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It tastes as sweet as it did in my youth.
choice_data_list: どうだ？
どうかな？
choice_data_list_en: How is it?
What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And yet... I feel as though this sweetness
is
conjuring some new emotions that
weren't there
before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Courage and a sense of vitality. This
taste gives
me the strength to face
hardships alongside those
who support
me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I doubt I could have experienced such
a taste if
I were eating this apple alone
right now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Strange, isn't it? From tiny
details to
treacherous paths...
Everything's cast in a
different light
when we're together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:

details to
treacherous paths...
Everything's cast in a
different light
when we're together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...For me, any race could be my last. And
I commit
all I have to every one I run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
But then... the thought of a peacefully
pleasant
tomorrow... Well, that's
wonderful too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Yes, I believe you would.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No matter what challenges may arise, let
us work
hand in hand to overcome them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
But... in the event that fatigue does
catch up with
me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I may need to take a brief rest on your shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, today's detour has turned into yet
another
wonderful experience. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It's because I spend some of my time on

endeavors such as these that I'm able to
clear my
head, switch gears, and focus
solely on achieving
my goals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to racing, I simply set my
sights on
the goal and run. It's clear and
simple.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Since, even beyond the goal, something

wondrous awaits—something we can only

experience together.
